response.overview: Astrid Nielsen, thirty, is an autistic woman who works quietly as a records officer for the judicial police and has an intimate knowledge of every case she has handled.  She meets Raphaëlle Coste, who is leading an investigation into the suicides of several doctors. The two solitary women gradually build a rapport: Astrid provides Raphaëlle with a methodology, while Raphaëlle, in turn, offers Astrid behavioral support.  Astrid uses her exceptional memory and keen eye for detail to solve criminal cases.
response.title: Astrid et Raphaëlle saison 1
